Sandbox_SimpleShopAllowManageItems_toolt: Allow players with management rights to change item prices and display order; when off, the button, the key bind and multiplayer price requests are all refused (off by default). Each player must also enable "Show Manage Items button" in Options -> Mods -> SimpleShop
Sandbox_SimpleShopConfigScope_tooltip:
Where the price table (items + display order) is stored.
Whole game (default): stored in Zomboid/Lua/SimpleShopPrices.ini and shared by every save and character, so a new save starts with the same shop.
This save only: stored in the current save; another save falls back to the default list.
Switching keeps the current price table, nothing is lost.
